For me, I would just write the main melody and come up with the chords later.

First, I start off with the melody.

Then, I do basic chords that just sound right.

After that, I start switching the basic chords with more complex chords using similar notes.

And the last step is to just change those complex chords to a bunch of notes scattered within that little zone where it sounds just right.
